steps.body: PLACEHOLDER: this chapter is still being written, and Snake ToolBox is not going to pretend otherwise. Here is where you will understand why threads do not speed up CPU-bound Python and use asyncio for real (I/O-bound versus CPU-bound, the GIL, event loops, async and await hands-on). Threads and processes are taught conceptually, and the 3.14 free-threading shift is taught as learn-the-model-not-the-ruleset (date-stamped). asyncio runs in-browser; real threads do not, and no lab pretends otherwise. The full version is on the way. For now this page is an honest signpost of where the road goes next, not the lesson itself.
